kind: Real React provider/Iris in jsdom, semantic vendor button/chat-host stand-ins, no Chrome/visual claim

checks.name: One existing header interceptor opens the new contextual panel and focuses its composer
A sent question produces clearly labeled computed facts, hypothesis and contributing evidence
Applying a new scope retains old evidence and requires an explicit context choice
Keep previous context permits another question without rewriting earlier answers
Use current view adopts the new scope for later questions while preserving earlier answer scope
Access revocation cannot expose denied financial context and disables authoring
Unavailable assistant retains the question, offers retry and manual evidence without blocking the workspace
Retry computes against the same frozen context and restores evidence actions
Escape closes the panel and restores focus to its original header entry
Opening a scope dialog closes Iris so panels do not stack
Local demo reset clears prior assistant exchanges without affecting the existing header entry
